notes: The ASV writes no pronominal adverb for בּוֹ, so rule 22's fusion does not reach it: אֲשֶׁר takes *that*, בְּ takes the stranded *upon*, and the resumptive suffix s009 is `unrepresented`. The object *it* is the separate suffix s013 on נְתַתִּיו.
כַּאֲשֶׁר fused to one *as* with the source head on the governing opening morpheme (rule 23).
כָּל־הַמָּקוֹם is rendered attributively as *Every place*, so no *of* is written and rule 28 governs rather than rule 19.
